content.short: An NFT-permissioned social club comprised of Cardano blockchain explorers who have common interests in the blockchain space.
content.description:
Black Doge is an NFT-permissioned social club comprised of Cardano blockchain explorers who have common interests in digital assets, metaverse activities, digital art/NFTs, and community.

The ultimate goal of the Black Doge DAO which backs the Black Doge Club community by building a portfolio of metaverse real estate holdings and various other NFTs and fungible tokens. To date, several Black Doge CNFT collections have been released in collaboration with artists from within the community, and more are planned in the future.
